claim: After the loss of Polonnaruwa as a durable capital, successive centres such as Dambadeniya and Yapahuwa represent not simple collapse but a political adaptation in which sovereignty was reassembled around more defensible sites, changing settlement patterns and different revenue geographies.
bounded_by: Different capital moves had different immediate causes. This claim does not reduce the whole transition to defence or imply a single centrally planned relocation strategy.
notes: Run39 promotes the mobile-capital mechanism from shell to bounded research material.
